cas03.emptyText: Remove a filter to see other cases.
cas03.endFiltered: No more cases match the filters.
cas03.errTitle: The queue could not be loaded
cas03.lostText: This page of results is no longer valid. You are back on the first page, with the same filters.
cas03.noScopeText: No case has been assigned to you yet. Ask your supervisor to assign one.
cas03.noScopeTitle: No case is in your scope yet
cas03.noneText: A new case appears here as soon as it is received.
cas03.sortNote: Soonest due first. Cases with no date running come last.
cas03.title: Case queue
cas04.alreadyProtected: This case is already a protected matter.
cas04.appealUnmeasured: No due date, because no appeal period was approved for this case type when the decision was issued
cas04.closeApproverHelp: A case officer other than you and the owner.
cas04.closeDialogText: The case becomes {state}. Every request still open ends as not supplied. The raiser is told the reason and the reopening deadline. The case reopens only on new evidence or an authorised decision.
cas04.closeInadmissible: Closed as inadmissible, when a classified case turns out to be outside the intake matrix. The raiser is told the reason and the route it should take instead.
cas04.closeIncomplete: Closed as incomplete, when the response period has ended and the case cannot proceed on what was supplied. A second case officer, other than the owner, approves it.
cas04.closeRoute: Route the matter should take instead
cas04.closeRouteHelp: Where the raiser can take it, in words they can act on.
cas04.errTitle: We could not load this case
cas04.matterLabel: What happened, in the raiser's words
cas04.needRoute: Name the route it should take instead.
cas04.needSubject: Choose what the case is about.
cas04.needVulnerability: Record the vulnerability: yes, no or not asked.
cas04.noApprover: No other case officer can approve. The closure needs one other than you and the owner.
cas04.noCategory: No protected category has an approved policy yet. The security owner prepares one on the case policy register, and the data protection officer approves it.
cas04.noPartiesText: The raiser holds no account and is reached at the address they gave.
cas04.processHelp: The process and the body that will handle it, as the raiser should read it.
cas04.protectAbout: For a suspected fraud, privacy, security, corruption or legal concern. Access is restricted from the instant it is recorded, before anything else happens.
cas04.protectDialogText: From now on only the category's access list can read the case, except anyone the matter names. If you are not on that list, you lose access too. The matter goes to the specialist process.
cas04.protectedText: Restricted since {t}. Only the category's access list can read this case, except anyone the matter names. Routed to {process}, now {state}.
cas04.referAbout: When the matter belongs to another process. RightOne stops handling it and the case does not come back. The raiser is told which process has it.
cas04.referDialogText: RightOne stops handling the matter. The case is referred and cannot come back, and the raiser is told which process has it, in the words you gave.
cas04.referDialogTitle: Refer {ref} to the process you named?
cas04.remedyHelp: One of the remedies this case type offers.
cas04.subjectsHelp: Each is excluded from reading it, whatever list they are on.
cas04.title: Case {ref}
cas04.unestablishedHelp: If left empty, the items still asked for are named instead.
cas04.vulnerabilityHelp: From what the raiser said, never inferred from their group. “Not asked” is an answer.
cas04.whyClassify: The case is not classified yet.
cas04.whyClose: Only a classified case, or one awaiting evidence, is closed this way. Status now: {state}.
cas04.whyDecide: Only a case under investigation or ready to decide can be decided. Status now: {state}.
cas04.whyInvestigate: Investigation starts only once the case is classified or assigned. Status now: {state}.
cas04.whyReady: Only a case under investigation can be marked ready to decide. Status now: {state}.
cas04.whyRefer: Only a classified case can be referred. Status now: {state}.
cas04.whyRemedy: The case has no decision yet.
cas04.whyReopen: Only a closed case can be reopened. Status now: {state}.
cas06.addItemHelp: What it is, in words the case team and the parties can act on. 500 characters at most.
cas06.cancelText: {party} will be told it is no longer needed, with the reason you give.
cas06.closedState: A request can be sent only while the case is classified, assigned, under investigation or awaiting evidence. Status now: {state}.
cas06.disclosureWhen: Chosen when the request is sent, before anything arrives.
cas06.dueHelp: Within the approved {n} working days, by {d} at the latest.
cas06.emptyText: When a party's evidence is needed, send a request below with its deadline and disclosure.
cas06.emptyTitle: Nothing has been asked for on this case
cas06.errTitle: We could not load the requests
cas06.heldEmptyText: An item arrives against a request, or is added below.
cas06.heldEmptyTitle: Nothing is held against this case yet
cas06.itemHelp: Words the party can act on. 500 characters at most.
cas06.noPolicy: No period is approved for this case type, so no request can be sent.
cas06.reasonHelp: The party the request addressed will read this.
cas06.recordAbout: A response by post, at the counter or by telephone. Record what arrived, even if nothing did. You are recorded as the person who wrote it down. What arrived carries the request's disclosure: {disclosure}.
cas06.recordSuppliedHelp: Describe the item, or why the party will not supply it. 500 characters at most.
cas06.recordTitle: Record a response that arrived another way: “{item}”
cas06.title: Evidence requests: {ref}
cas06.whyCancel: Only the officer who sent the request, or the case owner, cancels it.
cas06.whyOverdue: The deadline has passed, so this request can no longer be cancelled. Record a late answer, or decide the case without it.
cas07.authorityHelp: The instrument or delegation relied on.
cas07.errTitle: We could not load this case
cas07.factsHelp: The facts relied on, apart from the reasoning.
cas07.groundWhy: Recorded as a value of its own so these decisions can be reconciled with the refund rule once it takes effect.
cas07.issueText: {party} is told the decision now, with the appeal route and a deadline of {d}. Once issued, it cannot be edited.
cas07.issueTextNoDeadline: {party} is told the decision now, with the appeal route. Once issued, it cannot be edited.
cas07.makerHelp: This name appears on the decision. Whoever makes the decision may not decide its appeal.
cas07.noDeadline: No appeal period is approved for this case type.
cas07.noFinancial: This remedy has no financial effect, so nothing needs linking.
cas07.reasoningHelp: Why those facts produce this remedy.
cas07.routeHelp: Where an appeal is lodged, in words the party can act on.
cas07.title: Decide case {ref}
cas07.told: What the party will be told
cas07.toldText: The decision, the route, and a deadline of {d}.
cas07.whyOwner: You own and investigated this case, so another officer records its decision.
cas07.whyState: Mark the case ready to decide first. Status now: {state}.
cas09.confirmText: The appellant is told the outcome now, with the further route. It cannot be edited once recorded.
cas09.confirmTitle: Record the outcome of the appeal on {ref}?
cas09.effectiveHelp: When the new remedy takes effect.
cas09.errTitle: We could not load this appeal
cas09.furtherHelp: Where the party can take it next, if anywhere.
cas09.grounds: The grounds, in the appellant's words
cas09.lateText: This appeal arrived after the date the decision gave, so it is recorded as late. It must still be answered.
cas09.nowText: Another dispute authority takes it. If nobody eligible is left, the sponsor is told before the period ends.
cas09.onlyAuthority: Only a dispute authority records the outcome.
cas09.period: Period applied: {n} working days, version {v} of {from}.
cas09.remedyHelp: Only where the outcome changes the remedy. It then needs an effective date too.
cas09.title: Appeal against the decision on {ref}
cas09.unmeasured: No outcome date, because no appeal period was approved for this case type when the decision was issued.
cas09.unmeasuredText: No appeal period was approved for this case type when the decision was issued, so the appeal has no outcome date and does not lapse. It must still be answered. The case owner approves the period.
cas09.whyConflict: You made or approved the decision under appeal.
cas10.blockedTail: Closing now would leave the ledger entry unexplained.
cas10.completeOpen: Every required artefact is linked and names the case.
cas10.completeText: Every required artefact is linked and names the case. The case closed on {d}.
cas10.emptyText: This remedy has no financial effect, so nothing needs linking.
cas10.errTitle: We could not check the linkage
cas10.noAuthority: You hold no linking authority here.
cas10.nothingToLink: Every artefact you may link names the case.
cas10.readNote: “Names the case” is read from the module that holds the artefact, at the time shown. Re-check reads it again.
cas10.refHelp: The reference the owning module gave it: a calculation, an invoice number, a corrected inspection record, a notice.
cas10.title: Remedy linkage: {ref}
cas15.authoriseText: The case returns to investigation. Displaced: {displaced}. The earlier decision stays readable.
cas15.cannotText: You proposed it, so an independent authority must authorise it.
cas15.emptyTitle: This case has not been reopened
cas15.errTitle: We could not load this case
cas15.evidenceOn: Date the evidence came to exist
cas15.evidenceOnHelp: Needed for new evidence. It must post-date the decision.
cas15.notClosed: The case is {state}. Only a closed case is reopened.
cas15.nothingNote: Choosing “Nothing is displaced” is an answer. Leaving every box blank is refused.
cas15.onlyOfficer: A case officer proposes a reopening. A dispute authority authorises it.
cas15.proposer.raiser: The raiser, on their own case
cas15.refuseReason: Why the ground is not sufficient
cas15.refuseText: The case stays closed and the earlier decision stands. The reason you give is kept with the proposal, and the proposer reads it.
cas15.restsOnHelp: The evidence or the decision the ground rests on.
cas15.title: Reopen {ref}
cas15.whyAuthority: Only a dispute authority authorises a reopening.
cas16.approveText: This version governs every case raised from {d}, and the version in force ends that day.
cas16.effectiveHelp: After the start of the version in force, and not before today.
cas16.emptyText: The effective version is the one below.
cas16.errTitle: We could not load this version
cas16.newVersion: Prepare a new version from the one in force
cas16.routesHelp: Every group needs at least one route that works without an account.
cas16.routesMissing: Every route needs a group, a kind and whether it needs an account.
cas16.title: Case-intake matrix
cas16.unanswered: Every route needs a group, a kind and whether it needs an account.
cas16.whatText: A case raised on or after its effective date is resolved against it, and stays explained by it afterwards.
cas16.whyPast: The effective date has passed. The preparer needs to choose another.
cas16.whyRole: A business approver approves this version.
cas16.whySame: You prepared this version, so a different approver must approve it.
cas18.access: Who can read a matter in it
cas18.accessHelp: Named people. Anyone a matter names is excluded from it, whatever this list says.
cas18.alternateHelp: Where a concern goes when it is about the first.
cas18.cannotText: You prepared it, so a different approver must approve it. Until then, it governs nothing.
cas18.categoryAbout: Until a category has an approved policy, no case can be classified into it.
cas18.codeHelp: Lower case, no spaces, unique in the register.
cas18.emptyText: Until an entry is approved, the cases that read it are refused rather than defaulted.
cas18.errTitle: We could not load this register
cas18.label: Label
cas18.labelHelp: The words a case officer will read in a list.
cas18.processHelp: The process a matter in this category is routed to.
cas18.reachesBack: Appeal {reference}, on a decision issued {d}, was lodged while no period was approved. A version effective from {from} would reach back to it. Prepare it again from a later date.
cas18.refuseText: It stays prepared and governs nothing. The reason you give is shown to whoever prepared it.
cas18.title: Case policy register
cas18.unmeasuredText: These appeals were lodged while their case type had no approved appeal period, so they have no outcome date. Approving one now does not reach back to them. They must still be answered.
cas18.whyRole: A business approver approves it on behalf of the case owner.
cas18.whyRoleCategory: The data protection officer, or a business approver who did not prepare it, approves a category policy.
cas18.whySame: You prepared this, so a different approver must approve it.
casAp.errTitle: The queue could not be loaded
casAp.noAppealsText: An appeal a party lodges against a decision appears here.
casAp.noReopeningsText: A case officer's proposal appears here for someone else to authorise.
casAp.title: Appeals and reopenings
casNew.contact: Email or telephone number of the caller
casNew.contactWhy: We use this to acknowledge the case and to send the decision. Read it back to the caller.
casNew.errTitle: We could not load the ways in
casNew.line: The case goes in on the group's support line, which needs no account. The caller is its raiser, and you are recorded beside them.
casNew.matter: What happened, in the caller's words
casNew.matterHelp: As the caller tells it. 4,000 characters at most.
casNew.meta: Recorded on the support line, for a caller who may hold no account.
casNew.noLine: {group} has no support line in the matrix in force, so a case cannot be recorded for them here.
casNew.recordedNoNotice: Read the reference {ref} back to the caller. No acknowledgement could be sent to {contact}, so tell the caller the case was received.
casNew.recordedText: Read the reference {ref} back to the caller. The acknowledgement goes to {contact}.
casNew.refusal.GROUP_NOT_IN_MATRIX: No version of the intake matrix lists this group, so its case cannot be recorded. The case owner adds the group on the case-intake matrix.
casNew.refusal.MATRIX_VERSION_NOT_APPROV: This group's ways in are only in a version that has not been approved. A case can be recorded on them once the business approver approves it.
casNew.refusal.ROLE_NOT_ASSIGNED: You do not hold the support-line role, so you cannot record a case for a caller. Ask your administrator to assign it.
casNew.title: Record a case for a caller

casops.code.reopen_ground.authorised_dec: A decision of a dispute authority
casops.disclosureHelp.confidential_to_ca: The other party sees that it exists but cannot read it.
casops.disclosureHelp.open: The other party may read what is supplied.
casops.disclosureHelp.sealed: Opened only by the decision maker, where needed.
casops.element.effective: an effective date, today or later

casops.ground.inspection_rules: The rules on inspection records and their reconsideration
casops.outcomeHelp.upheld: The decision stands and its remedy is unchanged.

casops.reason.VULNERABILITY_RAISED: The recorded vulnerability raised the priority one band.
casops.registerAbout.appeal_decision: The working days within which an appeal is decided, from receipt, per case type.
casops.registerAbout.evidence_response: The working days a party is given to answer a request for evidence, per case type.
casops.registerAbout.pause_ground: The grounds that allow a clock to be paused or its target changed, and the authority each requires.
casops.registerAbout.protected_category: The categories handled under restricted access, the specialist process and the access list of each.
casops.registerAbout.remedy_requirement: The artefacts each remedy kind requires before the case can close.
casops.registerAbout.reopen_ground: The two grounds on which a closed case may be reopened.
casops.registerAbout.reopen_window: How long after closure new evidence may be offered, per case type.
casops.registerAbout.statutory_limit: A deadline an instrument sets, capping the target of a case type.
casops.registerHow.protected_category: The security owner prepares a category policy here. The data protection officer, or a business approver who did not prepare it, approves it. Until a category has one, no case is classified into it.
casops.registerHow.remedy_requirement: A remedy's artefacts change through a new approved entry. This screen only reads the register.
casops.registerHow.statutory_limit: A statutory limit is approved by the legal owner, because its value comes from an instrument. This screen only reads the register.
